name: fbgemm_linear_fp16_weight_fp32_activation
description: Representative ATen signature, copied verbatim: aten::fbgemm_linear_fp16_weight_fp32_activation(Tensor input, Tensor packed_weight, Tensor bias) -> Tensor. This chosen overload is representative only and is NOT an exclusive ABI: the original Gems pytest defines and owns the full contract for every registered overload, positional and keyword call form, return shape/dtype/device, error behavior, aliasing and mutation, so tests must never be narrowed, removed or have reference semantics adapted to fit this one signature. Registered schema strings supplied by the schema evidence, listed verbatim (there is exactly one): aten::fbgemm_linear_fp16_weight_fp32_activation(Tensor input, Tensor packed_weight, Tensor bias) -> Tensor. Semantics derived from the correctness and benchmark sources: this is the host FBGEMM fused linear path. packed_weight is an opaque handle produced by torch.ops.aten.fbgemm_pack_gemm_matrix_fp16 from a host float32 weight of shape (out_features=N, in_features=K); it is not a dense byte tensor and is never mutated by the op. input is the activation and must be float32 with rank >= 2, whose last dimension is K; rank 0 and rank 1 are rejected natively. The single float32 result has shape activation.shape[:-1] + (N,), lives on the same device as input, and equals the fp16 packed-weight matrix product plus the trailing bias add, so the bias participates in type promotion (int8/uint8/int32/int64/float16/bfloat16/float32/float64/bool are accepted; complex and float8 biases are rejected) and may be a single element broadcast over the leading dimensions or a length-N vector, with other shapes rejected. A length-K mismatch between input and packed_weight, a non-float32 activation, and an unpacked weight argument are all rejected. Autograd differentiates only through the trailing bias add: the activation gradient is unused/None while d(out)/d(bias) is a reduction over the leading dimensions, and no operand is mutated. K=0 is a metadata-only case because FBGEMM's cblas_gemm_compute writes only inside its k_ind < k loop.
